newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander rise helped by foreign business.
newsitem.headline: Santander rise helped by foreign business.

text.p: Banco Santander chairman Emilio Botin said on Monday that a rise of 13.22 percent in nine-month attributable profit stemmed from the consolidation of its position in Spain and from foreign operations.

"These results reflect the excellent evolution of recurrent income generated by the group, which stems from a strategy focused on consolidating its position as the leading financing institution in Spain and taking advantage of opportunities in other markets in order to increase group profitability and add value for shareholders," Botin said in a letter to shareholders.
